answer: Probably not. Offers are good for 5 days or 250 additional miles, whichever comes first, so an offer made on October 29 would expire around November 3. Moving your appointment doesn't extend the offer, and a new time keeps your offer only if it's on or before the expiration date. Your exact expiration date is on your offer page and in your confirmation email. If you'd like to keep this offer, choose a new time on or before that date. You can reschedule online or by replying to your confirmation text, up to 2 hours before your appointment starts. If you still want November 4, you can ask for a new offer at any time, but it will be based on current market prices and could be higher or lower.
